caption:
Quiet mornings in Tokyo, still close to Shibuya 🌳
Stay on the park side.

🗺️ Why not the quiet stations nearby?
They look close on the map,
but each one means changing trains every night.

🥇 Shibuya's north side, near Yoyogi Park
🚶 Walk home from dinner. No last train to catch.
🌅 Some hotels here are under 1 km from the park,
so a morning walk is easy.

🥈 Yoyogi-Hachiman, for early risers
🌳 Yoyogi Park is open all day and free.
⚠️ The catch: you change trains at Shimokitazawa
every night.

💡 Skip Yoyogi-Uehara for this.
It's mostly apartments, with very few hotels.

🕌 Bonus: Japan's largest mosque, Tokyo Camii,
is 5 minutes from Yoyogi-Uehara Station.
It's free to visit.
